title: Scene 3 · Prop card: the painkiller strip, almost used up
line: The painkiller strip on the kitchen table, all but one pocket torn open and empty
note: for SH04 — the user's Fix: the pill bed was still complete
imagePrompt: Photographed as a single frame from a US feature film, shot on an ARRI Alexa Mini LF in large format with an ARRI Signature Prime at 50mm and T4, the camera on a locked tripod at standing eye height, composed natively for a vertical 9:16 frame with no letterbox bars. A prop reference card for one object: one used silver blister strip of painkillers, the plain kind from a chemist, lying flat on a plain seamless mid-grey backdrop in soft even daylight from the left, seen from slightly above, filling about half the frame. The strip has exactly ten pockets in two rows of five. Eight pockets are empty: their clear plastic domes crushed flat and the silver foil behind each one torn open in a ragged split. Only the last two pockets, at the right-hand end, still hold a white tablet under unbroken foil. One corner of the foil is bent up. Plain: no brand, no logo, no printing and no writing anywhere on it. Across the bottom of the card, on a plain white strip, one caption line in small black sans-serif text: "PROP · Scene 3: the painkiller strip, almost used up". Negatives: no hands, no people, no box, no second strip, no full strip, no text other than the caption.

imageVersions.note: SH04 Fix: the pill bed was still complete
